$comment: Not a description of the values - values.yaml is that. Only what a value must never be. auth._drawnSessionSecret and valkey._drawnPassword are where kubetower.sessionSecret and kubetower.valkeyPassword remember what they drew for the rest of one render; set from outside, the first would skip the 32-character check and the second would put a password of the user's choosing - an empty one included - in place of the one already in the cluster. Helm validates this before rendering, so the chart's own writes are never refused.

trustedProxies.$comment: A list of addresses or CIDR ranges, or one string of them. A map or a boolean would otherwise render as text the console refuses at start, far from the value that caused it.

usernamePrefix.$comment: Compared with "-" in NOTES. A boolean or a number - `--set usernamePrefix=true`, or an unquoted `no` in a values file - would otherwise fail there with an error that names no value.

extras.$comment: The extra pages, by key: rendered as KT_EXTRAS, where a comma or an = would change the meaning of the list. A string - `--set extras=alfa`, without the braces - is refused here, naming the value, rather than failing inside a template with an error that names none.
